t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Gnomes appear in the same colour combinations and each coloured gnome gives out a different number of mushrooms. When it is x1 switch to test them.

vb_textbox.text: The 2 gnomes always appear in the same colour combinations. Try to keep track of who finds the most mushrooms - it can range from 0-9 per round. A good time to try & compare is during rounds which are x1.The 'good' gnomes can change at any time so don't get complacement - if they start to perform poorly maybe try out the other gnome in the pair again.
